review_text: I've been unable to log into my Instagram account on my device, even though the same account works perfectly in a web browser. I've emailed Instagram support multiple times, but I haven't received any response. This has been a very frustrating experience. I expected better customer support, especially for a platform used by millions of people. At the moment, I can't recommend this app because it feels like customer issues are not being given enough attention.
